column1: # gc_safe_point_contract_floor.tsv -- THE DECLARED FLOOR of the safe-point contract, ONE LINE PER WITNESS.
# ⛔ IT IS A NAME SET AND NOT A TOTAL, and the reason is the coo's rule of 2026-09-21, taken in the cto's
# words and sharpened in theirs: A GATE WHOSE POPULATION IS A DIRECTORY GLOB CANNOT CARRY A BLOCKING VERDICT
# WHEN THE DIRECTORY IS SHARED -- either the population is a DECLARED NAME SET or the verdict is REPORTED.
# ../harness/scripts/gc_witnesses/ is written by five seats; a witness ARRIVING is a file addition and must never be
# read as this tree getting worse, while a NAMED witness's own numbers MOVING is the whole thing this gate
# exists to catch.  A witness not named here is REPORTED and never blocking.
# 2026-09-22 cto: hb_coexpr_genp_scan.icn undecidable 8 -> 14, spine_cell 8 -> 16.  The cfo's bc1092d8f put
# x86_rt_gc_poll_res at the two by-name call sites; the four reached at two depths are now PLACED as SPINE-CELL at
# every depth (owner_ks), and the six in the co-expression body plus one call_value beta site reach NO ANCHOR and
# are NAMED POLL-RES-ENVELOPE.  A poll ARRIVING at a site this reader cannot place is a site that was UNPOLLED before,
# not the tree getting worse; the RSP-parity screen (CEO-1151) grades those seven in the bare-poll row.
# 2026-09-25 cto: five Prolog witnesses re-declared, UNDECIDABLE only, every added row K3 NO-ANCHOR-REACHES-SITE in a Prolog
# call box (the class this reader already could not place at 958 of these rows): findall 234 -> 294, root_cells 214 -> 274,
# pldb 152 -> 210, batch_b 210 -> 274, atom_dup 148 -> 154.  1186 of them were on origin 496b24635, identical on a control and
# on the IR_BOUND cure (hq_prolog's lowering landings); the last 20 with 15 new sites bisect to 7691706a8 (nl/0 permission).
# 2026-09-26 cto: the five Prolog witnesses re-declared again, UNDECIDABLE only: findall 294 -> 298, root_cells 274 -> 278, pldb 210 -> 214,
# batch_b 274 -> 278, atom_dup 154 -> 160 (sites +13/+13/+13/+13/+14). ATTRIBUTED BY A PER-COMMIT CENSUS (a worktree per commit, this checker over
# the five witnesses, first-parent bisect c41ae1e9b..2d6418900 in three rounds): every witness moves at cfe655263 (hq_prolog 2026-09-25 16:46, every
# term writer on a binary current output raises permission_error) -- b921002ef, its first parent, reads the old floor exactly -- by 10 sites and 4
# UND each, and the later +1..+3 sites (22cca29bf, 2d6418900) moved no clause. The same K3 NO-ANCHOR-REACHES-SITE class in Prolog call boxes as
# the 09-25 re-declaration; a lawful landing, not a regression of the emitted safe-point sequence.
# 2026-09-26 hq_prolog (R7 of the Prolog rewrite, ARCH-PROLOG-BB-REWRITE.md section 11, row prolog-bb-is-2-comparison-and-type-tests-compute-inline-...):
# the five Prolog witnesses re-declared, UNDECIDABLE only, K1..K5 at 0 on every row before and after: findall 298 -> 322 (sites 481 -> 488),
# TWO CAUSES, BOTH IN src/templates/bb/bb_call_pl_leaf.cpp: an is/2 box now carries two polls (one behind rt_pl_is_cold, one behind
# rt_pl_dop_unify) where the one leaf carried one, which is the +sites; and every $ax_/$cmp_/$is_v/$atop_/type-test/guard site now derefs
# its operands in an inline loop before its cold call, and the poll behind that loop reads K3 NO-ANCHOR-REACHES-SITE where the straight-line
# leaf call before R7 was placed -- the same class as the 09-25 and 09-26 rows above, in the same Prolog call boxes. Control arm: the
# pre-change tree (0dd682acd) built in a worktree reads the old floor exactly (7 of 7 arms) on the same machine in the same hour. Not a
# regression of the emitted sequence: the result stores still precede the poll at every site (K2 0) and the parity clause holds at every
# poll (misaligned 0); the reader's anchor walk does not cross the loop's back-edge, which is the reader's limit, named here and not cured.
# k5 is the RSP-PARITY clause (CEO-1151, cto 2026-09-22): a poll call at rsp 8 mod 16 on any path from its function's
# own entry (a box entry ASSUMED on the grid, a called function at 8), which misaligns every C callee on that path.
